Name: Animated Food and Drinks
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[size=6][b][u]Animated Food and Drinks

[/u][/b][/size][size=3]Adds animations for food and drinks! Check out the config file to disable/enable animations if you don't like some of them (more information below).
[/size]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/aQqc5fm.gif[/img][/center][center][/center][size=2]2.0.0 Changed the mod name to Animated Drinks, added Beer & Pale Ale animations.
2.0.1 Fixed a bug.
2.1.0 Added Life Elixir and Oil of Garlic.
3.0.0 Changed the mod name to Animated Food and Drinks, added a ton of new animations.
3.1.0 Updated Coffee, Green Tea and Triple Shot Espresso to match. Left old versions in the config.
3.2.0 Added more options for Coffee, Green Tea and Triple Shot Espresso.
3.3.0 Changed the steam on Triple Shot Espresso.
3.3.1 Fixed the Oil.
[/size]3.4.0 Added animations for recipes added with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry Mod[/url].
3.5.0 Converted to CP and SpaceCore

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/EoCnSz4.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/jhTTTNm.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/K7Z380s.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/5nAAe9E.gif[/img][/center]

[u][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/u]
[size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore﻿[/url]
Drop the mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder, load up the game. Enjoy :)[/size]
[size=5][u][b]
Config[/b][/u][/size]
[size=3]There is a [i]config.json[/i] in the mod folder where you can disable/enable each animation. Simply change "true" to "false", if you want to disable or reverse if you want to enable an animation.
You can also change the speed of the animation in the [i]content.json[/i] file, change the "AnimationFrameTime": x, to however long you want the animation to be.

[size=3]Some items have different versions, for example: "Pizza1" and "Pizza2". [/size][size=4][b][u]You can only have one of these enabled in the [i]config.json [/i]at one time[/u]. [/b][/size]
